text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Argentinian President Carlos Menem on Tuesday held a meeting with visiting President Ben Ali on boosting cooperation.
- Tunisian Tourism and Handicrafts Minister Slaheddine Maaoui held talks with his Libyan counterpart Boukhari Hawda on reinforcing cooperation in tourism.
- Kuwaiti foreign affairs minister received Tunisian trade minister and discussed trade.
- Tunisia and Italy started discussing opportunities for industrial cooperation.
- President Ben Ali on Tuesday delivered a speech in Argentinian parliament.
- Airliner Tunis Air announced on Tuesday it will increase its flights to France.
- Industry minister on Tuesday received his Egyptian counterpart Maher Abaza and Morocco energy minister
